description: Rename a player or set their gender/level/note. Updates MANY in one call: pass `updates` with one object per player and never loop one-by-one — setting levels for a whole roster used to be one call per player, which on a phone meant approving each one and left the roster half-updated when some were mis-tapped. The whole batch applies or none of it does.

level.description: Any consistent numeric level/rating — used only for seeding and balancing

note.description: Free note shown on the tournament page. Pass an empty string to clear it.

player_name.description: Single update; or use `updates` for several

request_id.description: Optional idempotency id — retrying a call with the same id never applies it twice

tournament_key.description: The tournament's organiser key (starts with tk_)

updates.description: Bulk edit — e.g. levels for a whole roster in one call
